semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Vimic Electronic Corp. provides consumable tools and precision parts primarily for the IC, LED, and LCD industries, which are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Vimic Electronic Corp. specializes in providing high-quality consumable tools and precision parts for the semiconductor industry, particularly in the IC, LED, and LCD sectors. Their product offerings include dispensing nozzles, epoxy stamping tools, and pick-up tools, catering to major electronics manufacturers across Asia and the USA.
capabilities: Dispensing nozzles for IC and LCD applications
Epoxy stamping tools for precision assembly
Pick-up tools and die collets for handling small components

regional_presence.Taiwan: Vimic cooperates with major IC companies and electronics manufacturers located in Taiwan.
regional_presence.Japan: The company has an R&D center in Tokyo focused on molding technology.
regional_presence.United States: Vimic serves electronics manufacturers in the USA.
